title: Coming Home
voice_anchor: COMIC_DESIGN_BRIEF.md §1.3 (character voice typography) + §3.3 (Vita Strip bubbles) + §3.6 (Vita Strip narrative voice)
architecture_locks_honored: §1.4 witness-only — bubbles overlay character-to-character dialogue only; UI chrome (Continue button, scroll indicators, tap hints) is structurally separate from speech; no second-person reader-address in character dialogue
§1.6 English-default, rare canonical Greek — zero Greek codepoints in this scene; welcome flow is journey-initiating, not Pascha
§1.7 Father Nicholas deferred — not present in this scene
§1.8 Mom present-in-world, never authored as speaker — not present in this scene as speaker
§11.7 Pascha-gold reservation — gold appears only as structural ornament (bubble borders, closing flourish ☩); no dialogue text rendered in gold
framing_note: Per D2 §0: welcome flow runs BEFORE the home dashboard renders. Replaces the placeholder hero frame in js/welcome-flow.js (Chat 4 _renderHeroFrame, retired Phase C). Does not orient Nolan to features; introduces Theo and Christopher and establishes the register the whole app inhabits. The Vita Strip is intentionally un-personalized (no name greeting) — the icon-distance posture (§1.4) is preserved when the strip is about Theo and Christopher, not about Nolan as protagonist. Card 4 of the downstream instruction cards continues to carry the personalized Greek welcome that lands the name greeting in the canonical place (rendered there in GFS Neohellenic, not in this scene).

revision_history.action: JSON corpus authored from D2 §1 canonical YAML; engineering layer materialized in js/vita-strip.js

panels.alt_text: Christopher kneels beside a small lantern at a dawn camp, closing a leather satchel. Theo sits nearby, a blanket around his shoulders.
panels.speaker: christopher
panels.dialogue_text: Up, son. The light is good.

panels.alt_text: Theo and Christopher walking together on a stone path, three-quarter back view, the monastery dome faintly visible in the distance.
panels.speaker: theo

panels.alt_text: Christopher half-turned toward Theo with his hand on Theo's shoulder; the monastery closer now in the mid-distance.
panels.speaker: christopher
panels.dialogue_text: Home, son. We have been a long time away.

panels.alt_text: Theo and Christopher from three-quarter back, both looking up at the monastery dome rising above the cypress trees.
Theo and Christopher at the threshold of the monastery, Theo's head tilted slightly as he listens toward the doorway.
panels.speaker: theo

closing_flourish.caption_en: Glory to God for all things.
closing_flourish.rendering_note: Per D2 §1 closing_flourish + D1 §3.7: DOM overlay BELOW the strip, NOT baked into Panel 5. Crimson Text Italic, 0.95em, ink #3A2817 at 80% opacity, centered. Ornament ☩ in Byzantine Gold #C9A84C, ~4-6px vertical gap above the caption. Under prefers-reduced-motion: appears immediately rather than fading.

consumer_notes: Static JSON corpus consumed by js/vita-strip.js. Mirrors C4 (reception-day-entries-v1.json) and C3 (saints/topic-00-saints-v1.json) shape conventions. Per-panel speaker/dialogue_text/bubble_position drives bubble rendering; silent:true on Panel 4 suppresses bubble entirely. closing_flourish drives DOM overlay below the strip. Image URLs use the /Orthodox-Expedition-/ GitHub Pages prefix; loader fetches the JSON itself from the same prefixed path so sw.js v52+ STATIC_ASSETS serves it from cache when offline.
